t.why: Wedged between India and China, it balances between the two. Money sent home by workers abroad is a large part of the economy.
t.rel: A Himalayan landlocked country between India and China. It relies heavily on India for trade and supplies, while widening road and rail links with China to keep a balance.
t.korea: Many Nepalis come to work in Korea under its Employment Permit System.
t.know: Nepal's flag is the only national flag in the world that is not a rectangle.
t.etext: Money sent home by people working abroad is a large part of the economy. Himalayan tourism and hydropower are its growth industries.
